walk.zh: 一队小脚踩着同一条影子。
walk.en: A row of small feet shares one shadow.

walk.zh: 四只小鼠排成一列前进。
walk.en: Four mice advance in a single file.

walk.zh: 我数着同伴的尾巴走路。
walk.en: I count my family's tails as we walk.

walk.zh: 墙缝里的家还等着我们。
walk.en: The nest in the wall is waiting for us.
The smallest one always trails behind.

walk.zh: 我们贴着草根悄悄挪动。
walk.en: We slip along the grass roots, keeping low.

walk.zh: 一只带头，其余三个紧随。
walk.en: One leads; the other three follow close.

walk.zh: 细爪子踩过石板没声音。
walk.en: Tiny claws cross the flagstones without a sound.

walk.zh: 我们绕开大路走屋檐下。
walk.en: We take the eaves, away from the open road.

walk.zh: 队伍整齐得像一串珠子。
walk.en: Our line is neat as a string of beads.

walk.zh: 我回头确认孩子们都在。
walk.en: I look back to make sure the little ones are here.

walk.zh: 搬家这天，全家一起上路。
walk.en: Moving day: the whole family travels together.

idle.zh: 我把籽壳堆成小小一堆。
idle.en: I stack seed husks into a tidy little pile.

idle.zh: 谁在啃我耳朵？是小家伙。
idle.en: Someone is nibbling my ear; it's the little one.
The afternoon sun warms the fur on my back.
We doze in one warm huddle.
One of the family grooms my fur for me.
A quick count: one, two, three, four.
I have nibbled the grass short by our burrow.

idle.zh: 最小的那只又爬到我背上。
idle.en: The smallest has climbed onto my back again.

idle.zh: 我们互相碰鼻尖打招呼。
idle.en: We greet each other with a touch of noses.
The grain goes into the deepest crack in the wall.
One sneeze wakes the whole family.
I wear my front teeth down at the doorway.

idle.zh: 夜色落下，我们靠得更近。
idle.en: As night falls we press closer together.

idle.zh: 两只小鼠为半粒种子吵起来。
idle.en: Two mice squabble over half a seed.

look_player.zh: 你的靴子比我们全家都大。
look_player.en: Your boot is bigger than our whole family.
Your shadow spreads wide when you crouch.

look_player.zh: 别踩，我们四个都在这里。
look_player.en: Watch your step; all four of us are down here.

look_player.zh: 你手里那袋果子晃得响。
look_player.en: That bag of berries rattles in your hand.
We line up and look at you together.

look_player.zh: 你是来抓我们的训练家吗？
look_player.en: Are you a trainer come to catch us?

look_player.zh: 精灵球在腰间晃了一下。
look_player.en: The ball at your belt just swayed.

look_player.zh: 小人儿躲到我身后去了。
look_player.en: The little ones hid behind me.

look_player.zh: 你的脚步太重，地都在抖。
look_player.en: Your steps are heavy; the ground shakes.
We are not one; we are a family.

look_player.zh: 你眼睛跟着最小那只跑了。
look_player.en: Your eyes followed the smallest one.
Looking up at you makes my neck ache.

look_player.zh: 你要是蹲下，我们就不怕。
look_player.en: If you crouch down, we won't be afraid.

tempted.en: That handful of grain smells wonderful.

tempted.zh: 树莓落了一地，我们能搬。
tempted.en: Berries fell everywhere; we could carry them.

tempted.zh: 孩子已经朝你手心走了。
tempted.en: The little one is already walking to your palm.

tempted.zh: 半块饼干够全家吃一天。
tempted.en: Half a biscuit would feed us all day.
I stay still and stare at your fingers.
The seeds you scattered are still rolling.
My nose twitches; my feet move on their own.

tempted.zh: 一家老小都在等我点头。
tempted.en: The whole family waits for me to nod.
That fruit pit still holds a trace of sweetness.
Let the smallest eat first; I can wait.

collide.en: Oops, I bumped into the toe of your boot.
All four of us bounced back at once.
Sorry, the line couldn't stop in time.

collide.zh: 你脚边太滑，我打了个滚。
collide.en: It's slippery by your feet; I rolled over.

collide.zh: 我的胡须扫到了你裤脚。
collide.en: My whiskers brushed your trouser leg.
The little one spun right around from the bump.
Don't lift your foot; we're still down here.

collide.zh: 这不算打架，只是撞上了。
collide.en: This isn't a fight; we just collided.

collide.zh: 我挡住同伴，自己挨了一下。
collide.en: I shielded the others and took the knock.
Two steps back, and we line up again.

mate.zh: 我在找愿意一起筑巢的伴。
mate.en: I'm looking for a partner to build a nest with.

mate.zh: 两家的孩子能凑成一群。
mate.en: Our two families' children could make one big group.
The way you sway your tail is very polite.

mate.zh: 先一起搬够过冬的粮食。
mate.en: First let's carry enough grain for the winter.

mate.zh: 我愿意把洞口让给你半尺。
mate.en: I would give you half my burrow entrance.

mate.zh: 我们的脚印会并成一排。
mate.en: Our footprints will merge into one line.

mate.zh: 这个巢够大，容得下两家。
mate.en: This nest is big enough for two families.

mate.zh: 等幼崽出生，我们一起守夜。
mate.en: When the pups come, we'll keep watch together.
Don't rush; take my scent first.

pickup.zh: 我捡起一颗滚来的种子。
pickup.en: I pick up a seed that rolled this way.

pickup.zh: 这块布头能给幼崽垫窝。
pickup.en: This scrap of cloth will line the pups' nest.
Half a grain of rice counts as a good meal.
I drag the fruit peel back into the wall crack.
A pebble? No, a hard candy.
I found a feather; it's very soft.

pickup.zh: 这个够轻，孩子也搬得动。
pickup.en: This is light enough for the little ones to carry.
I carry it in my teeth and the line sets off.
Anything dropped on the ground can be useful.
Let the smallest one hold it first.

target_acquire.zh: 那只甲虫挡了我们的路。
target_acquire.en: That beetle is blocking our path.
It's bigger, but there are more of us.
Bite its leg; I'll take the lead.
Little ones, back up; I go first.
This prey will feed the family twice.
It turned; this is our chance.
Pin it down; don't let it run.
My teeth itch; I want to try them.

targeting.en: It looks left, so we go right.
Don't blink; we pounce without warning.

targeting.zh: 最小的那只绕到后面了。
targeting.en: The smallest has slipped around behind.
It steps back; we step forward.

targeting.zh: 咬合力不大，但牙齿很多。
targeting.en: Our bite is small, but we have many teeth.
When it tires, we all move in.

targeting.zh: 我的尾巴在给同伴打信号。
targeting.en: My tail is signalling to the others.
This bite goes for the ankle.

melee_attack.en: I leap and cling to its leg.
My front teeth hit shell and go numb.

melee_attack.zh: 小家伙咬完就躲回我身后。
melee_attack.en: The little one bites and hides behind me.
This bite only tears off a tuft of hair.
I ram its flank with my body.
We take turns; it can't hold out.

spawn.zh: 墙根下钻出一排小脑袋。
spawn.en: A row of small heads pops out at the wall's base.

spawn.zh: 我们从一个洞里挤出来。
spawn.en: We squeeze out of a single burrow.

spawn.zh: 草丛里传来细碎的脚步。
spawn.en: Tiny footsteps rustle in the grass.
A family of four, all in order.

spawn.zh: 最小的先探头，我随后跟上。
spawn.en: The smallest peeks first; I follow.
This grass is soft enough to settle in.
We shake the dirt off our backs.

spawn.zh: 洞口还留着旧年的谷壳。
spawn.en: Old husks from last year still litter the entrance.

spawn.zh: 先数一遍，确认都出来了。
spawn.en: A quick count to confirm everyone is out.

spawn.zh: 我把最小的叼到安全处。
spawn.en: I carry the smallest to a safe spot.

spawn.zh: 这一带没有大脚印，很好。
spawn.en: No large footprints around here; good.
Our new home sits in a sheltered crack.

generic.en: Ouch, my fur is standing on end.
I guard my belly and fall back.
The family gathered around me at once.
My legs feel weak; I can't stand steady.

generic.zh: 最小的吓得钻进我怀里。
generic.en: The smallest burrowed into my side in fright.
I can still run; don't worry.
A patch of fur is torn; it will grow back.
Don't stop; we retreat to the wall crack.

fire.en: Fire singed my tail; the burnt smell is sharp.

fall.zh: 从高处摔下，爪子先着地。
fall.en: I fell from a height and landed on my paws.

drown.en: Water fills my nose; I paddle hard.

explosion.en: The blast scattered the whole family.

magic.zh: 咒光钻进骨头，又麻又冷。
magic.en: The spell sank into my bones, numb and cold.

starvation.en: The stores are empty; my belly touches my spine.

lightning.zh: 雷劈在洞口，我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lightning.en: Lightning struck the burrow; my ears ring.

void.zh: 脚下没有地，全家往下坠。
void.en: No ground beneath us; the whole family falls.
